projectTitle: LetsFG — flights and hotels for AI agents
description: Search and book flights across hundreds of airlines and booking sites, plus real bookable hotel rates, refundable and non-refundable. Python, JS and MCP.
rules: One credential covers flights AND hotels: the card-backed PFS Bearer token from the connect flow (hosted MCP at https://letsfg.co/developers/api/mcp, consent opens letsfg.co/connect, 0.00 Revolut setup), or a Developer API key. Hotel endpoints resolve either (require_api_key_or_pfs_token) — the same card authorises both products.

Hotels require a payment method on file for SEARCH as well as booking — a hotel search opens a real session at the supplier, so it returns 402 without a card. the connect flow already puts one there, so an agent that connected for flights is already set up for hotels.

Hotel booking is asynchronous. POST /hotels/book returns a booking_job_id, not a booking. Poll GET /hotels/booking/{job_id} until status is succeeded, failed or attention. attention means a person at LetsFG is confirming the outcome with the supplier: the hold is kept, nothing is charged, do not book again.
Never re-POST /hotels/book while its job is running — poll the job. A retry with the same idempotency_key returns the existing job (duplicate: true) instead of booking twice.

Hotel booking holds the full price on the connected Revolut method and captures it only once the hotel confirms; a failed booking releases the hold. There is no reservation fee, no deposit and no pay link (that process was retired on 2026-09-11).
Every hotel rate type is sold, refundable and non-refundable. Show refundable and free_cancellation_until before booking; a non-refundable rate cannot be cancelled for a refund.

Send expected_price, expected_cost, currency and fx_rate back to /hotels/book exactly as the chosen /hotels/search offer returned them, or the booking is refused as price_mismatch. There is no expected_balance.
A succeeded hotel booking carries confirmation, total_price and currency (what the guest is charged), refundable, free_cancellation_until and terms. The guest is e-mailed however the booking ends.
Do not call /agents/register or /agents/connect-payment for flights. Those create a paid prepaid billing account most agents do not want; connect through the hosted MCP instead.

A flight search returns in 8-10 s to first results, but `status: completed` is NOT the end. Poll GET /api/results/<id> immediately and then every 2s; keep polling while `split_ticket_pending` or `gf_enrich_pending` is true. The cheapest offer often merges in AFTER the status turns terminal. Bound the wait so a flag that never clears cannot hang the client.

Some flight offers are SPLIT TICKETS: two separately-issued tickets through a hub from two different sellers. They carry split_ticket="true", combo_type="virtual_interlining" and self_transfer="unprotected". Always tell the user: the tickets are not linked, so a missed connection means the second airline owes nothing - no rebooking, no refund. Never present a split ticket as one through-fare.
